_comment: Tellus Plus — English (fallback language; every key below must exist here).
tellusplus.name: Tellus Plus
_comment.themes: One entry per id in ArnisSources.MAP_THEMES (8 of them): the config screen builds the key dynamically as 'tellusplus.theme.' + mapTheme(), so a missing entry would show the raw key string. Ids are read straight out of MAP_THEMES, not guessed.
tellusplus.screen.manage.need_world: Clearing the cache needs you to be in a world (the delete runs on the server).
tellusplus.screen.manage.need_world_map: Open the map from inside a world - a map opened from the title screen cannot download.
tellusplus.screen.manage.clear_requested: Asked the server to clear the %s cache; the result appears in chat.
tellusplus.screen.manage.title: Tellus Plus — World & Data
tellusplus.screen.manage.subtitle: Data source, celestial body, map theme and cache — changes apply to newly generated terrain.
tellusplus.screen.manage.tooltip.source: TELLUS uses the fine-grained DEM chain (national high-precision DEMs, ESA WorldCover, Overture). ARNIS uses the arnis chain (Mapterhorn global elevation first, then AWS, plus NASA rasters for other planets).
tellusplus.screen.manage.tooltip.celesti: Chooses the planet: Earth, the Moon or Mars. Off Earth the base map switches to the planetary imagery used by arnis.
tellusplus.screen.manage.tooltip.theme: The base-map style drawn in the map screens and the minimap. Cycling moves through the built-in presets.
tellusplus.screen.manage.tooltip.cache: When on, terrain tiles are written to disk as they arrive, so re-entering the area does not download them again.
tellusplus.screen.manage.footer: Settings are written to config/%s and take effect on the next world generation.
tellusplus.screen.manage.footer.pending: Changes are saved. Newly generated terrain will use them; already-generated chunks keep their shape.
tellusplus.cache.clear.tooltip: Delete this cache folder. Terrain regenerates from the network next time, so nothing is lost permanently.
tellusplus.cache.clear.partial: Cleared %s, but some files were still in use and were left behind.
tellusplus.cache.clear.failed: Could not clear %s — see the log for details.
tellusplus.about.title: About Tellus Plus
tellusplus.about.body: Tellus Plus regenerates Earth at scale in Minecraft: terrain, land cover and water are sampled from real geographic data and the result is written into the world as it generates.
tellusplus.about.credits: Based on Tellus by Yucareux. Distributed under LGPL-3.0-only.
tellusplus.hud.where_am_i.scale: Scale %.3g m/block   Elevation %.0f m  8x8 chunks  tile z=%d
tellusplus.hud.tiles_loading: Map tiles loading... (showing a coarser level for now)
tellusplus.preload.progress: Downloaded %d tiles / %.1f km^2  (green = downloaded, grey = not yet)
tellusplus.command.only_in_tellus_world: Tellus Plus: /tellus %s is only available in a Tellus world.
tellusplus.command.config_hint: Tellus Plus: the settings screen is at Mod Menu -> Tellus Plus -> Config (data source / celestial body / map theme / cache usage / box-select delete).
tellusplus.command.preload.started: Tellus Plus: background preloading started. The server keeps running during the download and will report when it finishes.
tellusplus.command.preload.would_flood: Tellus Plus: that area would queue %d tiles, which is far more than the download pool can serve. Narrow the box and try again.
tellusplus.command.preload.recorded: Tellus Plus: %d regions recorded, about %.1f km^2 in total (default layers: buildings + roads).
tellusplus.command.storage.deleted: Tellus Plus: deleted region %d from the %s ledger.
tellusplus.command.storage.cleared: Tellus Plus: cleared the %s ledger (%d regions).
tellusplus.command.storage.index_out_of_: Tellus Plus: index %d is out of range; there are %d regions in this ledger.
tellusplus.command.storage.unknown_sourc: Tellus Plus: unknown data source '%s'. Use tellus or arnis.
tellusplus.command.area.invalid: Tellus Plus: the box is invalid — %s
tellusplus.command.area.limit: Tellus Plus: the box is %d chunks across; local coordinates must stay within +/-%d. Current latitude/longitude %.5f, %.5f (scale %.3g m/block).
tellusplus.command.texture.help: /tellus storage delete <index>  delete one region;  /tellus storage clear <tellus|arnis>  empty that ledger
tellusplus.earthdata.unavailable: Tellus Plus can use NSIDC High Mountain Asia 8 m DEM tiles, but they need Earthdata credentials.
tellusplus.earthdata.token_hint: The token is stored locally in config/tellus-hma-access.properties.
tellusplus.earthdata.how: In-game handling: bytes are range-read from the official swisstopo swissALTI3D COG tiles.
tellusplus.earthdata.source.beck: Source: Beck, H.E., Zimmermann, N.E., McVicar, T.R., et al. (2018).
tellusplus.earthdata.koppen: Köppen-Geiger climate classification (1 km, Beck et al., 2018)
tellusplus.error.arnis_needs_mirror: Tellus Plus: the arnis data source needs the mirror proxy, but mirror.enabled=false or no domain is configured.
tellusplus.warn.ocean_depth_fit: Tellus Plus: configured oceanic scale %s -> effective %s (world-bottom limit %s, worldScale=%s heightOffset=%s minY=%s)
tellusplus.debug.world_settings: Tellus Plus world settings: scale={}, minAltitude={}, maxAltitude={}, heightOffset={}, limits=[minY={}, height={}]
tellusplus.theme.carto: Light minimal (Carto; may return watermarked tiles, needs your own key)
tellusplus.theme.openfreemap-liberty: Modern light (locally rendered vector, CJK labels)
tellusplus.theme.openfreemap-dark: Modern dark (locally rendered vector, CJK labels)
